newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ogawa Sec to be told to improve operations - sources.
newsitem.headline: Ogawa Sec to be told to improve operations - sources.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance plans to order Ogawa Securities Co, a financially troubled unlisted brokerage based in Osaka, to improve its operations as early as next week, government sources told Reuters.

Ogawa Securities submitted a restructuring programme to authorities in April but the ministry is likely to order the brokerage to upgrade its plan so it can substantially improve its operations quickly.
If Ogawa Securities cannot comply with the order, it may have to withdraw from the securities business.
The brokerage has asked Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd, which is a major shareholder, for support to restructure its business, including a boost in its capital.
A spokesman for Ogawa Securities was not immediately available for comment.
